𝗦𝗟 𝟳𝟭/𝟱 𝗜𝗡 𝟮𝟯! 🇱🇰🇵🇰

Sri Lanka are 71/5 after 23.2 overs in the 2nd Test at Rawalpindi.
Dhananjaya fell lbw to Razaullah; Kusal Mendis is on 24*.

Can SL recover? 👇
